t: Notice to Patients: New Booking System
en:
Starting next Monday, Greenway Clinic will use a new online system for every appointment and reservation. The goal is simple: shorter waits in the lobby and fewer mistakes at the front desk.

When you book online, you will see each option for the day, including the doctor's name and the fee for the visit. After payment, the system will send a receipt by email, so there is no need to wait for the cashier or the printer.

Patients who pick up medicine from the pharmacy on the first floor should show the label printed on their prescription bag. Each employee at the front desk has been trained for this task, and they can help anyone who is not comfortable using a computer.

If you have questions on this subject, please call the clinic during office hours.
zh:
從下週一開始，綠道診所的所有看診預約與保留都會改用新的線上系統。目標很簡單：縮短在大廳等候的時間，減少櫃檯的出錯。

線上預約時，你會看到當天的每個選項，包括醫師姓名和看診費用。付款後，系統會用電子郵件寄送收據，不必再等收銀員或印表機。

在一樓藥局領藥的病人，請出示印在藥袋上的標籤。櫃檯每位員工都受過這項工作的訓練，不習慣使用電腦的人也可以請他們協助。

若對此事有疑問，請於門診時間致電診所。
q: What is the main purpose of the new system?
第一段最後一句：The goal is ... shorter waits in the lobby，目的是減少等候時間。
How will patients receive a receipt?
the system will send a receipt by email，收據用電子郵件寄送。

en:
Dear Ms. Lin,

Thank you for your payment. This is a reminder that your room reservation at the Harbor Hotel begins on Friday. As a client of our business department, you will receive a discount on the room fare and free access to the meeting room on the third floor.

Our receptionist noticed that your flight arrives late at night. Because of the high volume of guests this weekend, please give us permission to keep your credit card on your account so the room is held for you. A staff member will also park your vehicle if you arrive by car.

The hotel site is close to the convention center, and the region has many restaurants and well-known brand shops. A short description of nearby places to visit is attached to this email.

Best regards,
Guest Services
zh:
林小姐您好：

感謝您的付款。提醒您，您在海港飯店的訂房將於週五開始。身為本飯店商務部門的客戶，您享有房價折扣，並可免費使用三樓的會議室。

我們的櫃檯人員注意到您的班機深夜才抵達。由於本週末住客量很大，請允許我們把您的信用卡保留在帳戶上，以便為您保留房間。若您開車前來，也會有工作人員幫您停車。

飯店位置靠近會議中心，這一區有許多餐廳和知名品牌商店。附件是附近景點的簡短介紹。

敬祝順心
住客服務部
q: Why does the hotel ask for permission to keep the credit card?
To hold the room for a late arrival
因為班機深夜才到、週末住客多，所以保留卡片以便為她保留房間。
What is included with the attachment?
最後一句：A short description of nearby places ... is attached。

en:
For the period from July to September, our office used more energy than in any other section of the building. In response, management has made a decision to change how we use equipment and materials.

First, every computer must run the new power-saving software, which shuts the screen off after ten minutes. Second, staff should print only the quantity of documents they need. Third, a sample of our electricity data will be checked every week so we can see whether the method is working.

The purpose of these changes is not to cut anyone's wage. The sum we save on fuel and electricity will be used to improve the employee lounge. This is a good opportunity for everyone to help. Attendance at a short training session on Friday is required.
zh:
七月到九月這段期間，我們辦公室的能源用量比大樓其他區域都高。對此，管理部門決定改變設備與材料的使用方式。

第一，所有電腦都必須安裝新的省電軟體，十分鐘後自動關閉螢幕。第二，員工只列印需要的文件數量。第三，每週會抽查一部分用電資料，看看這個方法是否有效。

這些改變的目的不是要減少任何人的薪資。省下來的燃料和電費總額會用來改善員工休息室。這是大家一起出力的好機會。週五有簡短的訓練課程，必須出席。
q: What will the money saved be used for?
The sum we save ... will be used to improve the employee lounge。
What must employees do on Friday?
最後一句：Attendance at a short training session on Friday is required。

en:
Air pollution in the Riverside district has become a growing concern. According to a recent article in the local paper, the figure for harmful dust rose by 15 percent last year.

The city has now announced a solution. A new device that measures air quality will be placed in every school, and the data will be published online so that people can check the status of their area at any time. The city will also offer free instruction to drivers on how to reduce fuel use.

"We have a variety of ideas, and we have confidence that conditions will improve," said the mayor. A local charity has agreed to plant trees near the bus departure station. Experts say that a cleaner environment can also support the growth of new businesses and raise property values.
zh:
河畔區的空氣汙染已成為日益嚴重的問題。根據地方報紙最近的一篇文章，有害粉塵的數值去年上升了 15%。

市政府現已宣布解決方案。每所學校都會設置一台測量空氣品質的裝置，資料會公布在網路上，讓民眾隨時查看所在地區的狀況。市政府也會免費指導駕駛人如何減少油耗。

市長表示：「我們有各式各樣的構想，也有信心情況會改善。」一個地方慈善團體已同意在公車發車站附近種樹。專家說，更乾淨的環境也能帶動新企業成長，並提高房地產價值。
q: Where will the new devices be placed?
A new device ... will be placed in every school。
A local charity has agreed to plant trees near the bus departure station。

en:
Hi team,

The budget for this year's sales conference has been approved, so we can now choose a venue. I have compared three facilities, and the Bayview Hotel has the biggest advantage: accommodation and the event hall are in the same building, and it is only ten minutes from the airport terminal.

I would like each colleague to update the shared spreadsheet with the number of guests from their area. Please note that the hotel requires a minimum of 80 guests. Admission is free for staff, and a beverage supplier will provide drinks at no extra cost.

We received a complaint last year about the sequence of talks, so this time an expert from the planning office will set the schedule. An official announcement will go out next week.

Thanks,
David
zh:
大家好：

今年業務大會的預算已經核准，現在可以選場地了。我比較了三個場地，海灣飯店的優勢最大：住宿和活動大廳在同一棟大樓，離機場航廈只要十分鐘。

請每位同事在共用試算表上更新各自區域的來賓人數。請注意，飯店要求至少 80 位來賓。員工免費入場，一家飲料供應商會免費提供飲品。

去年我們收到關於演講順序的抱怨，所以這次會由企劃室的專家安排議程。正式公告將於下週發出。

謝謝
大衛
q: Why was the Bayview Hotel chosen?
Rooms and the hall are in one building
accommodation and the event hall are in the same building 是它最大的優勢。
People complained about the order of talks
We received a complaint last year about the sequence of talks。

en:
Many small shops aim to attract new buyers with a big discount. However, the result is often short. A recent study shows that what really brings customers back is the experience they have after they buy something.

For example, one electronics store makes the refund process simple: customers fill out a one-page form, and the money is returned within three days. Another store offers free help to customers who cannot follow the product manual. Both stores reached their sales target this year, even though demand in their trade fell.

The lesson is clear. A lack of service can hurt a business more than a high price. A store does not need the power of a large company to win an award for service. It needs a clear process and staff who respond to every request.
zh:
許多小商店想用大折扣吸引新顧客，但結果往往很短暫。最近一項研究顯示，真正讓顧客回流的，是他們購買之後的體驗。

例如，一家電器行把退款流程變得很簡單：顧客填一頁表格，三天內就退款。另一家店則免費協助看不懂產品說明書的顧客。這兩家店今年都達到銷售目標，儘管整個行業的需求下滑。

道理很清楚：服務不足對生意的傷害可能比價格高更大。商店不需要大公司的實力也能贏得服務獎，它需要的是清楚的流程，以及會回應每個要求的員工。
q: According to the study, what brings customers back?
what really brings customers back is the experience they have after they buy something。
What is true about the two stores?
Both stores reached their sales target this year。

en:
The research team has finished the first draft of its report on working habits. The survey covered a wide range of workers in the private sector, and the results were not what we expected.

The most common problem was not low pay but a lack of rest. The typical worker in the study takes only one short break a day, and many reported negative effects on their physical health. A major reason is that meeting rooms are available for only a limited time, so people skip lunch to finish projects.

As a temporary solution, the team suggests a small experiment: each department will block out a regular thirty-minute break every afternoon. If the results are positive, the company may raise this as a primary goal for the whole network of offices next year.
zh:
研究團隊已完成工作習慣報告的初稿。這項調查涵蓋民營企業中各式各樣的員工，結果出乎我們預料。

最常見的問題不是薪水低，而是缺乏休息。研究中典型的員工每天只休息一次短暫時間，許多人表示身體健康受到負面影響。一個主要原因是會議室只在有限的時間內可用，所以大家會跳過午餐趕完專案。

作為暫時的解決方法，團隊建議做一個小實驗：每個部門每天下午固定排出三十分鐘的休息時間。如果結果正面，公司明年可能會把這列為整個辦公室網絡的首要目標。
q: What was the most common problem found?
The most common problem was not low pay but a lack of rest。
each department will block out a regular thirty-minute break every afternoon。

en:
Frequent travelers know how harmful it is to run out of battery on a business trip. The TravelPro charger, which won this year's annual design award, is a practical answer.

The device is small, portable, and suitable for various types of phones and laptops. It comes with a detailed guide and a spare cable. Unlike the original model, it stays stable even when used for many hours, and it is capable of charging two devices at once.

The only obvious problem is the price. It is unlikely to be cheaper than traditional chargers in local stores. Buyers should also be aware that the legal warranty is only one year, and repairs are due within thirty days of a request. Still, I am optimistic that most users will find it worth the entire cost.
zh:
經常出差的人都知道，出差時電池沒電有多麼糟糕。今年獲得年度設計獎的 TravelPro 充電器，是一個實用的解決方案。

這個裝置小巧、方便攜帶，適用於各種手機和筆電。它附有詳細的說明書和一條備用線。和原始型號不同，它長時間使用也很穩定，而且能同時為兩個裝置充電。

唯一明顯的問題是價格。它不太可能比本地商店的傳統充電器便宜。買家也要注意，法定保固只有一年，而且維修須在申請後三十天內完成。儘管如此，我樂觀地認為大多數使用者會覺得它值得全部的花費。
q: What is one advantage of the new model?
It stays stable for many hours
It is sold in local stores only
Unlike the original model, it stays stable even when used for many hours。
What is the main drawback mentioned?
The only obvious problem is the price。

en:
Dear members,

We would like to invite you to attend our spring workshop on customer service. Places are nearly full, so please book your seat immediately.

At the workshop, speakers will present ways to organize your team, respond to customer emails, and create a stronger brand. You will also compare real cases and learn how to apologize when a delivery is late.

After you register, please download the initial schedule from our website. If you need to cancel, let us know at least three days in advance so we can offer your place to someone else; we will remove your name from the list and secure a full refund. We will remind all guests one day before the event and deliver printed notes on the day.

We look forward to seeing you, and to recognizing the members who mentioned us to their friends.
zh:
各位會員好：

誠摯邀請您參加本會的春季客服工作坊。名額幾乎額滿，請立即預約座位。

工作坊中，講者會介紹如何組織團隊、回覆顧客郵件，以及打造更強的品牌。您也會比較真實案例，學習在送貨延遲時如何道歉。

報名後，請到我們的網站下載初步議程。若需要取消，請至少提前三天告知，以便把名額讓給其他人；我們會把您的名字從名單上移除，並確保全額退款。我們會在活動前一天提醒所有來賓，並在當天發送紙本講義。

期待與您見面，也將表揚向朋友推薦我們的會員。
q: What should people do after registering?
After you register, please download the initial schedule from our website。
How early must a cancellation be made?
let us know at least three days in advance。

en:
Bright Path Design is planning to hire an office assistant to help our growing team. We are developing new services and expect our client list to double this year.

The assistant will assist managers, confirm meeting times, arrange travel, and upload files to our system. The role also involves calculating monthly costs and checking that invoices contain the correct amounts. Experience with software we install on new computers is a plus.

We intend to offer a fair salary and flexible hours. Our goal is to attract people who can remain calm when plans change and who can represent the company politely on the phone.

To apply, send your résumé by May 30. We cannot afford to reply to every applicant, but we will contact those who match our needs. Please do not advertise this post on other sites.
zh:
明路設計正計劃雇用一名辦公室助理，協助我們成長中的團隊。我們正在開發新服務，預期今年客戶名單會加倍。

助理將協助經理、確認會議時間、安排差旅，並將檔案上傳到系統。這個職位也需要計算每月成本，並檢查發票是否包含正確金額。若熟悉我們在新電腦上安裝的軟體，會更加分。

我們打算提供合理的薪資和彈性工時。我們希望吸引在計畫改變時能保持冷靜、並能在電話中有禮地代表公司的人。

應徵請在 5 月 30 日前寄出履歷。我們無法回覆每位應徵者，但會聯絡符合需求的人。請勿在其他網站刊登這則徵才訊息。
q: What is NOT listed as a duty of the assistant?
文中提到安排差旅、上傳檔案、檢查發票，沒有提到設計產品。
What does the company say about replies?
Only suitable applicants will be contacted
we will contact those who match our needs，只聯絡符合需求的人。

en:
After much discussion, management has decided to introduce a new policy on remote work. We recommend that all staff read the attached document carefully.

Employees who wish to participate must first seek approval from their manager. They are required to stay reachable during office hours and to attend video meetings with their cameras on. To prevent security problems, staff may not use public Wi-Fi to access client files.

We will consider each request separately. Managers will identify which tasks can be performed from home and which cannot. Staff who rent shared offices may also apply.

We propose a three-month trial. If the number of complaints does not rise, we will offer remote work to all departments. Please do not interrupt team leaders with questions this week; instead, contact Human Resources.
zh:
經過多次討論，管理部門決定推出新的遠距工作政策。建議所有員工仔細閱讀附件。

想參加的員工必須先取得主管同意。他們必須在上班時間保持可聯絡，並開著鏡頭參加視訊會議。為了防止資安問題，員工不得使用公共 Wi-Fi 存取客戶檔案。

我們會分別考量每一份申請。主管會判定哪些工作可以在家完成、哪些不行。租用共享辦公室的員工也可以申請。

我們提議試行三個月。如果抱怨數量沒有增加，就會把遠距工作開放給所有部門。本週請勿用問題打擾組長，請改為聯絡人資部。
q: What must employees do first to work remotely?
Employees who wish to participate must first seek approval from their manager。
Who should staff contact with questions this week?

t: Launch of the New Delivery Service
en:
Fresh Basket today announced the launch of a same-day delivery service in three cities. The company expects the new service to increase sales by 20 percent.

Customers can now select a delivery time when they order, and they can update or transfer their order to another address until noon. Food that is damaged on the way will be replaced for free. To support the service, the company will hire 50 new drivers and repair its old trucks.

The change follows a ban on large trucks in city centers, which caused delays for many retailers last year. Customers have praised the plan, and early interviews show strong interest.

For more information, contact the media office. Journalists who wish to reserve a seat at the press event should do so in advance.
zh:
新鮮菜籃今天宣布在三個城市推出當日配送服務。公司預期這項新服務能讓銷售額增加 20%。

顧客現在下單時可以選擇配送時段，中午以前也可以更新訂單或把訂單轉到其他地址。運送途中損壞的食品會免費更換。為了支援這項服務，公司將雇用 50 名新司機並維修舊卡車。

這項改變是因應市中心禁止大型卡車進入，該禁令去年造成許多零售商延誤。顧客稱讚這個計畫，初步訪談也顯示大家很有興趣。

如需更多資訊，請聯絡媒體室。想預留記者會座位的記者請事先預約。
q: What happens to food damaged during delivery?
It is sold at a discount
Food that is damaged on the way will be replaced for free。
Why did retailers have delays last year?
The change follows a ban on large trucks in city centers, which caused delays。

en:
Regarding last week's construction industry conference, here is a short summary for those who could not attend.

The main trend discussed was the rising cost of building materials. One accountant explained how firms can balance their budgets when prices change suddenly. A well-known instructor also gave a talk on performance reviews for site workers.

Several competitors showed new home appliances that use less energy. Visitors who completed a short assignment received a certificate of attendance; please bring your identification to collect it from the front office.

Lastly, the organizers thanked us for our donation to the student program. If you have an interest in joining next year's event, note that the deadline for subscription is March 1. Please don't forget your briefcase; one was left in the hall after the event.
zh:
關於上週的營建業研討會，以下是給無法出席同仁的簡短摘要。

討論的主要趨勢是建材成本上升。一位會計師說明了價格突然變動時，公司要如何平衡預算。一位知名講師也就工地工人的績效考核發表演講。

幾家競爭對手展示了更省電的新家電。完成一份簡短作業的來賓可獲得出席證明；請攜帶身分證件到前台領取。

最後，主辦單位感謝我們對學生計畫的捐款。若有興趣參加明年的活動，請注意訂閱截止日期是 3 月 1 日。也請別忘了你的公事包，活動結束後大廳裡留下了一個。
q: What was the main trend discussed?
The main trend discussed was the rising cost of building materials。
What is needed to collect the certificate?
please bring your identification to collect it。

en:
At a ceremony held at city hall on Saturday, the mayor recognized 30 volunteers for their service to the community. The majority were retired workers who live on a small pension but still give their time.

Awards were given in each category, from transportation help for older residents to free classes on writing a résumé. One volunteer helped more than 200 people complete their job applications and registration forms.

In conclusion, the mayor announced the extension of the volunteer program for two more years. The city's employment division will also offer a small investment to cover each volunteer's travel expenses. "It was nobody's fault that the program had little money in the past," she said, "but our new policy will change that." Volunteers with a degree in teaching are especially welcome.
zh:
週六在市政府舉行的典禮上，市長表揚了 30 位為社區服務的志工。大多數是靠微薄退休金生活、卻仍付出時間的退休人士。

每個類別都頒發了獎項，從協助長者交通，到免費教人撰寫履歷的課程都有。一位志工協助超過 200 人完成求職申請和登記表格。

最後，市長宣布志工計畫延長兩年。市府就業處也會提供一小筆經費，負擔每位志工的交通費用。她說：「過去這個計畫經費少不是誰的錯，但我們的新政策會改變這一點。」特別歡迎具教育學位的志工加入。
q: Who were most of the volunteers?
The majority were retired workers who live on a small pension。
What did the mayor announce at the end?
the mayor announced the extension of the volunteer program for two more years。

en:
To: Plant Committee
From: Editor, Operations Newsletter

The outcome of last month's safety check shows that the plant needs a new maintenance plan. My proposal follows one simple principle: fix problems before they stop production.

Evidence from our database shows that most delays last less than an hour, but they happen often. In the short term, we can use a dashboard that warns workers when a machine needs care. This will lower labor costs and reduce the duration of each stop.

We also have an obligation to our workers. Several firms in our sector now offer training in digital literacy so that staff are not at risk of unemployment as factories change. I suggest we do the same. A superior structure for training will help us keep good people for the long term.
zh:
致：工廠委員會
寄件人：營運通訊編輯

上個月的安全檢查結果顯示，工廠需要新的維護計畫。我的提案遵循一個簡單原則：在問題讓生產停擺之前就先修好。

資料庫中的證據顯示，大部分延誤不到一小時，但發生得很頻繁。短期內，我們可以使用儀表板，在機器需要保養時提醒工人。這能降低人工成本，並縮短每次停機的時間。

我們對員工也負有責任。我們這個產業的幾家公司現在都提供數位素養訓練，讓員工不會因工廠轉型而面臨失業風險。我建議我們也這麼做。更好的訓練架構能幫助我們長期留住好人才。
q: What is the principle of the proposal?
fix problems before they stop production。
Why does the writer suggest digital training?
so that staff are not at risk of unemployment as factories change。

en:
Dear candidate,

Congratulations! You have been selected from more than 400 applicants for our graduate program. Below is some information to help you prepare.

Your first session will be a presentation by the head of administration on how the company manages its resources. After that, your supervisor will explain your priorities for the first month. There will also be a half-day excursion to our main warehouse, where we receive each shipment of merchandise.

The program works as a six-month trial. During this time, you will learn the basics of accounting and the needs of our consumers. Your improvement will be reviewed every two months.

We want to express our appreciation for your interest. Please bring your own laptop; the hardware will be checked at reception. We hope this program gives you strong motivation to grow with us, even in a difficult economy.
zh:
親愛的候選人：

恭喜！您從 400 多位應徵者中獲選參加本公司的儲備幹部計畫。以下資訊協助您做準備。

第一堂課是行政主管的簡報，說明公司如何管理資源。接著，您的主管會說明第一個月的優先工作。另外還有半天的參訪，前往我們的主要倉庫，那是每批商品送達的地方。

本計畫為期六個月的試用期。期間您會學習會計基礎和消費者需求。您的進步每兩個月評估一次。

感謝您對本公司的興趣。請自備筆電，硬體會在接待處檢查。即使經濟情況艱困，也希望這個計畫能給您強大的動力與我們一同成長。
q: What will happen in the first session?
Your first session will be a presentation by the head of administration。
How often will progress be reviewed?
Your improvement will be reviewed every two months。

en:
MEMO
To: Sales Team
Re: Singapore trip itinerary

The final itinerary for next week's trip is attached. Please note that there is a three-hour layover in Hong Kong on the way. The agenda for the client meeting has also changed, so read it before you leave.

A technician from our partner will meet us at the airport. He will explain the new office layout and our position in the shared building. Because the client is a new tenant there, we should not expect fast internet; please download files in advance.

All expense statements must be sent by courier or uploaded to the finance system by the end of the quarter. A large proportion of our sales this year comes from this region, and our reputation depends on this visit. Your feedback after the trip is welcome. Remember to bring your public transit card.
zh:
備忘錄
收件人：業務團隊
主旨：新加坡出差行程

下週出差的最終行程表已附上。請注意去程在香港有三小時轉機。客戶會議的議程也已變更，出發前請先閱讀。

合作夥伴的一位技術人員會到機場接我們。他會說明新辦公室的配置，以及我們在共用大樓中的位置。因為客戶是那裡的新房客，網路可能不會很快，請事先下載檔案。

所有費用報表都必須在本季結束前以快遞寄出或上傳到財務系統。我們今年有很大比例的業績來自這個地區，公司的聲譽就看這次拜訪了。歡迎大家出差後提供回饋。記得帶大眾運輸卡。
q: Why should staff download files in advance?
The client may have slow internet
the client is a new tenant there, we should not expect fast internet。
When must expense statements be submitted?
By the end of the quarter
must be sent ... by the end of the quarter。

en:
City FM reached an important milestone this month: one million listeners for its morning broadcast. The station's success is a result of its strong influence among young workers.

The program's host, Maria Chen, credits the station's new interface, which allows listeners to vote in a live debate every morning. "Our statistics show that each individual listener stays for about 40 minutes," she said.

The station also offers a reward to listeners who send news about traffic, strikes, and other problems on the road. Retail sponsors have increased, and profit rose by 12 percent last year.

Not everything has been easy, however. A contract conflict with a music company forced the station to change its rate for some songs. Starting next month, the station will add an evening lecture series and offer free access to past shows online.
zh:
城市電台本月達到重要里程碑：晨間節目有一百萬名聽眾。電台的成功來自它在年輕上班族中的強大影響力。

節目主持人陳瑪莉認為功勞在電台的新介面，它讓聽眾每天早上都能在現場辯論中投票。她說：「我們的統計顯示，每位聽眾平均收聽約 40 分鐘。」

電台也提供獎勵給傳送交通、罷工等路況消息的聽眾。零售業贊助商增加，去年利潤成長了 12%。

不過也不是一切順利。與一家音樂公司的合約衝突，迫使電台更改部分歌曲的費率。從下個月起，電台將新增晚間講座系列，並在網路上免費提供過去的節目。
q: What does the new interface allow listeners to do?
allows listeners to vote in a live debate every morning。
A contract conflict with a music company forced the station to change its rate。

en:
For freelancers and small firms, finding an affordable office can be difficult. Coworking spaces have become a popular option, and their impact on how people work is easy to see.

The best spaces are flexible: members can rent a desk by the day or by the month. Many offer complimentary coffee and printing, and some are adjacent to train stations. Unique features such as rooftop gardens help each space attract a diverse group of members.

However, the gross cost can rise quickly. Inexperienced users often forget about extra charges for meeting rooms. Before you sign, check whether the price includes ongoing services such as cleaning and internet.

The forecast for the industry is positive, given current economic trends and constant domestic demand. Still, the principal question for any business is simple: is the space effective for your specific needs, and is it relevant to your clients?
zh:
對自由工作者和小公司來說，要找到負擔得起的辦公室並不容易。共享辦公空間已成為熱門選項，它對人們工作方式的影響顯而易見。

最好的空間很有彈性：會員可以按天或按月租桌位。許多空間提供免費咖啡和列印，有些就在火車站旁邊。屋頂花園等獨特設施，讓每個空間都能吸引多元的會員。

不過，總費用可能很快就上升。沒經驗的使用者常常忘記會議室要額外收費。簽約前，請確認價格是否包含清潔、網路等持續性服務。

就目前的經濟趨勢和穩定的國內需求來看，這個產業的前景樂觀。但對任何企業來說，主要問題很簡單：這個空間對你的具體需求是否有效？和你的客戶是否相關？
q: What mistake do inexperienced users often make?
They choose spaces far from stations
They forget extra meeting room charges
Inexperienced users often forget about extra charges for meeting rooms。
What should people check before signing?
check whether the price includes ongoing services such as cleaning and internet。

en:
To make our new office more pleasant for everyone, we have prepared some additional guidelines. They are not permanent rules but reasonable steps that are appropriate for a shared space.

First, the meeting rooms are spacious, but please be cautious with noise. Verbal discussions longer than five minutes should take place in a room, not at your desk. Second, the internal kitchen is accessible to all, and there is an abundant supply of tea and coffee, but please clean up after yourself.

Third, any technical problem should be reported to the IT desk. Staff may also submit anonymous comments through an online form. Overall, the changes have been positive, and we see potential for even better teamwork.

Remember that a professional workplace is essential, especially when commercial clients visit. Thank you for your extensive feedback during the move. Medical supplies are kept in the cabinet next to the kitchen.
zh:
為了讓新辦公室對每個人都更舒適，我們準備了一些額外的指引。這些不是永久規定，而是適合共用空間的合理做法。

第一，會議室很寬敞，但請注意音量。超過五分鐘的口頭討論請到會議室進行，不要在座位上。第二，內部茶水間大家都可以使用，茶和咖啡供應充足，但請自行清理。

第三，任何技術問題請回報 IT 服務台。員工也可以透過線上表單提交匿名意見。整體而言，這些改變是正面的，我們也看到團隊合作更好的潛力。

請記得，保持專業的工作環境非常重要，尤其是有商業客戶來訪時。感謝大家在搬遷期間提供大量回饋。醫療用品放在茶水間旁的櫃子裡。
q: Where should long discussions take place?
Verbal discussions longer than five minutes should take place in a room。
How can staff give comments without their names?
Staff may also submit anonymous comments through an online form。

en:
Want to advance your career but have no time to commute to classes? Our online business English course lets you study at your own pace. Approximately 2,000 people enroll each year, particularly busy managers.

The course consists of 12 units. Each one helps you concentrate on a real task, such as how to postpone or reschedule a meeting politely. You will interact with teachers in live sessions and scan your homework for quick feedback. Moderate effort of about three hours a week is enough to achieve good results.

Many students hesitate because they worry the course will affect their work schedule. In fact, you can extend your study time at no cost. It is hard to predict how much you will improve, but most learners involve their whole team after finishing.

Part of every fee is donated to overseas education programs. Graduates are welcome to contribute by sharing their stories, and we will forward them to new students.
zh:
想提升職涯卻沒時間通勤去上課嗎？我們的線上商用英文課程讓你按照自己的步調學習。每年大約有 2,000 人報名，特別是忙碌的經理。

課程包含 12 個單元。每個單元幫助你專注於一項實際任務，例如如何有禮地延後或重新安排會議。你會在直播課中與老師互動，並掃描作業以獲得快速回饋。每週約三小時的適度努力，就足以達到不錯的成果。

很多學員猶豫是因為擔心課程影響工作行程。事實上，你可以免費延長學習時間。雖然很難預測你會進步多少，但大部分學員結業後會讓整個團隊一起參加。

每筆學費的一部分會捐給海外教育計畫。歡迎結業學員分享經驗來貢獻，我們會轉寄給新學員。
q: How many units are in the course?
Why do many students hesitate to join?
They fear it will affect work schedules
they worry the course will affect their work schedule。

en:
The board has approved a plan to upgrade the assembly line at our Taichung factory. Data from last year indicate that delays occurred twice a week, mainly because older machines were hard to maintain.

The new system will activate automatically when an order is submitted, and it will assign each task to the right station. Managers assure us that no jobs will be lost. In fact, the company plans to employ 30 more workers to operate the new machines.

It took time to persuade some team leaders. Several had suggested that we simply alter the current system. However, after reviewing the costs, they concluded that the upgrade would save money in the long run, and they were convinced.

The company will declare the project complete in June. Staff are encouraged to draw up ideas that will motivate teams during the change. Costs will shrink once the work is done.
zh:
董事會已批准升級台中工廠組裝線的計畫。去年的資料顯示，每週會發生兩次延誤，主要原因是舊機器難以維護。

新系統會在訂單送出時自動啟動，並把每項任務分派到正確的工作站。主管向我們保證不會有人失業。事實上，公司計劃再雇用 30 名員工來操作新機器。

說服部分組長花了一些時間。有幾位曾建議只要修改現有系統就好。然而在檢視成本後，他們得出結論：升級長期來看能省錢，因此被說服了。

公司將在六月宣布專案完成。鼓勵員工提出能在轉換期間激勵團隊的點子。工程完成後成本就會縮減。
q: What caused the delays last year?
Old machines that were hard to maintain
mainly because older machines were hard to maintain。
What did some team leaders first suggest?
Several had suggested that we simply alter the current system。

en:
We are pleased to announce that Kevin Wu has been appointed as Regional Manager for Southeast Asia, effective next month.

Kevin has worked with us for eight years. In his last role, he helped the sales team adapt to a changing market and customize products for local buyers. When a major customer threatened to withdraw its order, Kevin settled the dispute in two days. Under his lead, sales exceeded the target by 18 percent.

In his new position, Kevin will locate partners, invest in new markets, and demonstrate our products at trade fairs. He anticipates that his first task will be to eliminate costs that do not add value.

Kevin is committed to building a strong team. He asked us to quote one of his favorite sayings: "Small steps lead to big results." Please join us in congratulating him. More details will be shared at the next staff meeting.
zh:
我們很高興宣布，吳凱文獲任命為東南亞區域經理，自下個月起生效。

凱文在本公司服務八年。在前一個職位上，他協助業務團隊適應變動的市場，並為當地買家客製化產品。當一位大客戶揚言要撤回訂單時，凱文在兩天內就解決了爭議。在他的帶領下，業績超出目標 18%。

在新職位上，凱文將尋找合作夥伴、投資新市場，並在商展上展示我們的產品。他預期第一項任務是刪除沒有附加價值的成本。

凱文致力於打造堅強的團隊。他請我們引用他最喜歡的一句話：「小步伐帶來大成果。」請和我們一起恭喜他。更多細節將在下次員工會議分享。
q: What did Kevin do when a customer threatened to withdraw an order?
He asked the board for help
Kevin settled the dispute in two days。
What does Kevin expect his first task to be?
his first task will be to eliminate costs that do not add value。

en:
Thank you for registering with FitZone. Before you purchase a membership, please read the following terms.

Your membership is a 12-month lease of our facilities. A monthly charge will be taken from your card on the first day of each month. If a payment fails, your account will be in default, and access will be stopped until the problem is fixed.

You may convert your plan to a family plan at any time. Our app lets you track your workouts and features video classes from our sponsors. If any machine malfunctions, please report it at the front desk; we guarantee repairs within 48 hours.

We will try to sustain low prices, but fees may change. If you have any concern, you may file a complaint online. Members who exhibit good attendance may be nominated for our "Member of the Month" award. Lockers may not be occupied overnight. Any attempt to share your card will cancel the membership.
zh:
感謝您註冊 FitZone。購買會員前，請閱讀以下條款。

您的會員資格是 12 個月的設施租用。每月一號會從您的卡片扣取月費。若扣款失敗，您的帳戶會被視為違約，在問題解決前將暫停使用權。

您可以隨時把方案轉換為家庭方案。我們的 App 能追蹤您的運動紀錄，並提供贊助商的影音課程。若有任何器材故障，請向櫃檯回報，我們保證在 48 小時內修好。

我們會盡力維持低價，但費用可能調整。若有任何疑慮，可以在線上提出申訴。出席表現良好的會員可能被提名「每月之星」。置物櫃不可過夜占用。任何試圖共用會員卡的行為都會導致會員資格取消。
q: What happens if a payment fails?
your account will be in default, and access will be stopped until the problem is fixed。
How quickly will broken machines be repaired?
At the end of the month

en:
As part of our commitment to flexible work, the company is launching a program for freelancers. This decision was based on several factors, including the growing distribution of our clients across Asia.

Each freelancer will receive an orientation session and will be treated as a representative of the company when meeting clients. Compensation will be paid per project, and every transaction will be recorded in our online system.

The program also offers insurance coverage and access to our welfare fund. However, freelancers must meet strict criteria: work with any defect must be fixed at no cost, and all designs must pass review before release.

From a business perspective, this is an important foundation for future growth. The resolution passed by the board also allows freelancers to apply for mortgage support after two years. Publicity for the program will begin next week. Positions will be awarded based on merit.
zh:
為了落實彈性工作的承諾，公司將推出自由工作者計畫。這項決定是基於幾個因素，包括客戶在亞洲各地的分布越來越廣。

每位自由工作者都會參加新人說明會，與客戶會面時將被視為公司代表。報酬按專案支付，每一筆交易都會記錄在線上系統中。

這個計畫也提供保險保障和福利基金的使用權。不過，自由工作者必須符合嚴格標準：有瑕疵的成果必須免費修正，所有設計在發布前都必須通過審核。

從商業角度來看，這是未來成長的重要基礎。董事會通過的決議也允許自由工作者在兩年後申請房貸補助。計畫的宣傳將於下週開始。職位將依實力評定。
q: Compensation will be paid per project。
What must freelancers do if their work has a defect?
work with any defect must be fixed at no cost。

en:
All personnel in the production area must attend next Tuesday's seminar on workplace safety. The seminar is part of our strategy to improve efficiency without putting workers at risk.

Last month's inspection found that several machines were running beyond their capacity. Although there were no injuries, the inspector placed great emphasis on taking every precaution. Workers will learn how to check equipment before each operation and how to reduce energy consumption.

The session will be led by a vendor who supplies our safety equipment. The objective is to reach zero accidents this year, a prospect that management believes is realistic.

Please use the reference number on your badge to register. Those who miss the workshop will need to attend a make-up session at their own time. Light meals and other amenities will be provided. The seminar is free; the vendor will not charge a commission.
zh:
生產區的所有人員都必須參加下週二的工作場所安全研討會。這場研討會是我們在不讓工人承擔風險的前提下提升效率的策略之一。

上個月的檢查發現，有幾台機器的運轉超出產能。雖然沒有人受傷，檢查員仍特別強調要做好每一項預防措施。工人將學習如何在每次操作前檢查設備，以及如何減少能源消耗。

課程由提供我們安全設備的廠商主講。目標是今年達成零事故，管理階層認為這個前景是可實現的。

請使用識別證上的參考編號報名。錯過工作坊的人需自行利用時間參加補課。現場提供輕食和其他設施。研討會免費，廠商不會收取佣金。
q: several machines were running beyond their capacity。
What is the objective of the seminar?
The objective is to reach zero accidents this year。

en:
This report gives an overview of our expansion into Vietnam, which is now in its second phase.

The founder of our local partner corporation, Mr. Tran, has agreed to associate his company with ours for five more years. Our analysis shows that the transition has gone smoothly, although the workload for our Ho Chi Minh City team has doubled.

Innovation is key. We held a webinar for 300 buyers, and the intake of new customers rose sharply. Under the circumstances, we have also made a revision to our guideline on payments: clients may now pay in installments.

One hazard remains. The local tax authority has started an investigation into imported goods, which could slow our shipments. We also note that the withdrawal of a competitor from the market gives us a clear distinction. These factors make Vietnam our most valuable asset in the region.
zh:
本報告概述我們在越南的擴張，目前已進入第二階段。

當地合作公司的創辦人陳先生已同意與我們再合作五年。我們的分析顯示轉換過程很順利，不過胡志明市團隊的工作量增加了一倍。

創新是關鍵。我們為 300 位買家舉辦了網路研討會，新客戶的招攬數量大幅上升。在這樣的情況下，我們也修訂了付款準則：客戶現在可以分期付款。

仍有一項風險。當地稅務機關已開始調查進口商品，可能拖慢我們的出貨。我們也注意到，一家競爭對手退出市場，讓我們更具明顯區隔。這些因素讓越南成為我們在該區域最有價值的資產。
q: What change was made to the payment guideline?
Payments must be made in advance
clients may now pay in installments。
The local tax authority has started an investigation into imported goods, which could slow our shipments。

en:
The renovation of our headquarters will begin on May 1. Here is an overview of the procedure and what it means for each branch of the company.

The first floor will be closed during the installation of a new security system. As a consequence, all visitors must check in at the side entrance. Cubicles on the second floor will be replaced with an open layout to fit our growing headcount.

We apologize for any inconvenience. Our catering agency will continue to serve lunch, but the menu will be limited. Please do not leave chemical cleaning products in the kitchen, as workers will be moving heavy loads.

All invoices related to the project should be sent to the facilities team. We thank everyone for their contribution to this campaign to create a better workplace. An internal publication with photos of the new design will be shared soon.
zh:
總部的翻修工程將在 5 月 1 日開始。以下是程序概要，以及它對公司各分處的影響。

一樓在安裝新保全系統期間將關閉。因此，所有訪客都必須在側門登記。二樓的辦公隔間會改成開放式配置，以配合日益增加的員工人數。

造成不便，敬請見諒。我們的餐飲外包廠商會繼續供應午餐，但菜色會減少。請不要把化學清潔用品留在茶水間，因為工人會搬運重物。

所有與工程相關的發票請寄給總務團隊。感謝大家為打造更好職場這項行動所做的貢獻。一份附新設計照片的內部刊物即將發布。
q: all visitors must check in at the side entrance。
Why are the cubicles being replaced?
replaced with an open layout to fit our growing headcount。

en:
Our team met with Delta Supply last week to discuss a new contract. Here is an outline of the main points.

The biggest hurdle was a clause about delivery times. Delta wanted a span of 30 days, while we asked for 14. After a long dispute, both sides agreed to a compromise of 21 days.

Delta also made a remarkable offer: they will share their inventory data with us, so we can measure stock levels in real time. This approach should help cut downtime at our factory. We did object to one amendment on price increases, and Delta agreed to remove it.

One key characteristic of Delta is its strong revenue growth. A recent poll of buyers placed it among the top three suppliers in the region. If talks fail, our broker has an alternative supplier in the directory. The final timeline will be set by May 15. Delta's stance on payment terms remains firm.
zh:
我們的團隊上週與達美供應會面，討論新合約。以下是重點摘要。

最大的障礙是一條關於交貨時間的條款。達美要求 30 天的期限，我們則要求 14 天。經過長時間爭論，雙方同意折衷為 21 天。

達美也提出一個很出色的提議：他們會與我們分享庫存資料，讓我們能即時衡量存貨水準。這種做法應該有助於減少工廠的停工時間。我們反對一項關於漲價的修正條文，達美也同意刪除。

達美的一個關鍵特色是營收成長強勁。最近一項買家民調把它列為該區前三大供應商。如果談判破局，我們的仲介在名錄中有替代供應商。最終時間表將於 5 月 15 日前確定。達美對付款條件的立場仍然堅定。
q: What delivery time was finally agreed?
both sides agreed to a compromise of 21 days。
What will Delta share with the company?
they will share their inventory data with us。

en:
Our current file system is no longer sufficient for a team of our size. After comparing several services, the IT team recommends CloudBox for the following reasons.

First, it is reliable. In the past year, the service was down for less than an hour in total, which is vital for a company that works with external partners. Second, it is compatible with all our existing software, so no intensive training is needed. Third, staff can share files with anyone who is eligible, using a secure link.

It is also efficient. Numerous small tasks, such as backups, happen automatically. The apparent cost is higher than our current system, but adequate storage is included, and there is no fee for overdue payments.

Mutual trust with our clients is crucial, so data safety is critical. CloudBox uses artificial intelligence to spot defective files and unusual activity. Prior approval from managers is not compulsory for small teams. We have ambitious plans, and we believe this tool will support them.
zh:
我們目前的檔案系統對這樣規模的團隊已經不夠用了。比較幾項服務後，IT 團隊推薦 CloudBox，原因如下。

第一，它很可靠。過去一年，服務停機的總時間不到一小時，這對與外部夥伴合作的公司非常重要。第二，它與我們現有的所有軟體相容，不需要密集的訓練。第三，員工可以用安全連結把檔案分享給有權限的人。

它也很有效率。許多小工作，例如備份，都會自動完成。表面上的費用比現有系統高，但已包含足夠的儲存空間，而且逾期付款不收費。

與客戶之間的互信至關重要，所以資料安全非常關鍵。CloudBox 使用人工智慧偵測有問題的檔案和異常活動。小團隊不一定要事先取得主管同意。我們有遠大的計畫，相信這個工具能支持這些計畫。
q: Why is no intensive training needed?
it is compatible with all our existing software, so no intensive training is needed。
What does CloudBox use AI for?
Spotting defective files and unusual activity
CloudBox uses artificial intelligence to spot defective files and unusual activity。

en:
This year's Employee of the Year award goes to Lisa Huang from our finance department. Lisa has shown consistent results for three consecutive years.

Lisa is known for being precise and accurate. When the company was understaffed last spring, she worked with dedicated colleagues to finish the annual financial report on time. Her concrete suggestions also made our corporate budget more economical, saving a significant amount of money.

She also led training on how to handle confidential documents, which became mandatory for all staff this year. Many described the training as beneficial and said Lisa's enthusiastic teaching made a controversial topic easy to understand.

Lisa will receive a cash prize and an exclusive trip to our office in Tokyo. Her story is an authentic example of what our company values. The award ceremony will be intense but fun, so join us on Friday at 5 p.m. Insufficient seating means you should arrive early. Both white-collar and blue-collar staff are welcome.
zh:
今年的年度最佳員工獎頒給財務部的黃麗莎。麗莎已連續三年交出穩定的成績。

麗莎以精確、正確聞名。去年春天公司人手不足時，她與敬業的同事合作，準時完成年度財務報告。她具體的建議也讓公司預算更節省，省下了一大筆錢。

她也主持了如何處理機密文件的訓練，今年所有員工都必須參加。許多人表示這個訓練很有幫助，而且麗莎熱情的教學讓一個有爭議的主題變得容易理解。

麗莎將獲得現金獎金和一趟專屬的東京分公司之旅。她的故事是本公司價值觀的真實範例。頒獎典禮會很緊湊但很有趣，歡迎週五下午五點一起參加。座位不足，請提早到場。白領和藍領員工都歡迎參加。
q: What did Lisa do when the company was understaffed?
She finished the annual report on time
she worked with dedicated colleagues to finish the annual financial report on time。
Insufficient seating means you should arrive early。

t: Hiring Plan for the New Office
en:
We plan to establish a new office in Kaohsiung next year. To support this, Human Resources will recruit 25 people and explore new ways to retain staff.

We are looking for diligent workers who specialize in logistics. Candidates with experience at a wholesale company will qualify for a higher starting salary. Most roles are onsite, but some will be offered as remote positions in the equivalent of full-time hours.

The market for skilled workers is competitive. Many candidates are apprehensive about moving, so we will offer help with housing. We will also reinforce our training program so that new staff can learn quickly.

To avoid duplicate work, managers should send all job requests through HR. The company also plans to acquire a small local firm, which will help us further our growth in the south. We believe the new office will be primarily a center for customer service. Durable furniture has already been ordered, and we expect tremendous results. New opportunities will emerge as we grow, and we will convey updates monthly.
zh:
我們計劃明年在高雄設立新辦公室。為此，人資部將招募 25 人，並探索留住員工的新方法。

我們正在尋找專精物流、工作勤奮的人。具批發公司經驗的應徵者可獲得較高起薪。大部分職位需要在辦公室工作，但有些會以相當於全職時數的遠距職位提供。

專業人才市場競爭激烈。許多應徵者對搬家感到擔憂，所以我們會提供住房協助。我們也會加強訓練計畫，讓新進員工能快速上手。

為了避免重複作業，主管應透過人資部提出所有職缺需求。公司也計劃收購一家當地小公司，這有助於我們在南部進一步成長。我們相信新辦公室主要會是客服中心。耐用的家具已經訂購，我們期待亮眼的成果。隨著成長會出現新機會，我們每月都會傳達最新消息。
q: Who will get a higher starting salary?
Candidates with experience at a wholesale company will qualify for a higher starting salary。
What will the new office mainly be?
the new office will be primarily a center for customer service。

en:
The project team met on Monday to evaluate the first phase of the new billing system.

The team leader began by clarifying the goals. The system was implemented in March, and early data reveal that it generates invoices 40 percent faster. However, staff detected several errors in the way it specifies tax amounts. These errors have now been resolved.

IT staff were asked to analyze why the system consumes so much memory at night. Until this is fixed, the team will restrict access to reports after 10 p.m. and suspend automatic backups on weekends.

One supervisor asked whether customers should be compensated for the billing errors. After discussion, the team agreed it was hard to justify payments, since no customer had been charged too much. The team will continue to collaborate with the finance department and proceed to the next phase. The team will also renovate the server room. Note: one member, Mr. Ko, has resigned and will not fulfill his remaining tasks; he was not dismissed.
zh:
專案團隊週一開會，評估新帳務系統的第一階段。

組長先釐清目標。系統於三月導入，初步資料顯示它產生發票的速度快了 40%。不過，員工發現它在標示稅額時有幾個錯誤，這些錯誤現在已經解決。

IT 人員被要求分析系統為何在夜間消耗大量記憶體。修好之前，團隊會在晚上十點後限制報表的存取，並暫停週末的自動備份。

一位主管問是否應該補償客戶帳單錯誤。討論後，團隊認為很難說明付款的正當性，因為沒有客戶被多收費。團隊會繼續與財務部合作並進入下一階段。團隊也會翻新機房。附註：組員柯先生已辭職，不會完成剩下的工作；他並不是被解雇。
q: staff detected several errors in the way it specifies tax amounts。
Why will customers not be compensated?
since no customer had been charged too much。

en:
Dear valued customer,

We have decided to transform our loyalty program to better reflect what our members want. Here is what you need to know.

Starting in July, you can redeem points for travel and dining, not just shopping. To ensure your points are safe, we will validate your account by sending a code to your phone. Points that are not used within two years will expire and be discarded.

We acknowledge that the old program was confusing. After we consulted members, we adopted a simpler design that enables you to check your points in one tap. We must also enforce one new rule: points cannot be transferred to other people.

Please bear in mind that our partners determine the value of each reward. If you notice any mistake, let us know; we would rather not overlook a problem than have it expose your account to risk. We want to emphasize that your personal data will never be sold. Our company was founded on trust, and we will deduct no fees for this change. We undertake to restore any points lost due to system errors.
zh:
親愛的顧客您好：

我們決定改造會員忠誠計畫，以更符合會員的需求。以下是您需要知道的事項。

從七月開始，點數除了購物，還可以兌換旅遊和餐飲。為確保點數安全，我們會傳送驗證碼到您的手機以驗證帳戶。兩年內沒有使用的點數會過期並被作廢。

我們承認舊方案很令人困惑。徵詢會員意見後，我們採用了更簡單的設計，讓您一鍵就能查詢點數。我們也必須實施一項新規定：點數不能轉讓給他人。

請記住，每項獎勵的價值是由合作夥伴決定。若您發現任何錯誤，請告訴我們；我們寧可不忽略任何問題，也不願讓您的帳戶暴露在風險中。我們要強調，您的個人資料絕不會被出售。本公司以信任為根基，這次改變不會扣除任何費用。我們承諾恢復任何因系統錯誤而遺失的點數。
q: What happens to points not used within two years?
Points that are not used within two years will expire and be discarded。
What new rule will be enforced?
points cannot be transferred to other people。

en:
After careful study, the company has decided to relocate its main warehouse to Taoyuan. This move will enable us to distribute products faster and accommodate our growing number of orders.

The move will disrupt some services for about two weeks. To relieve pressure on staff, we will engage a moving company and prioritize urgent orders. Customers will be notified by email of any delay.

We have also modified our delivery plan. Larger orders will be accompanied by a tracking number, and regular customers can renew their contracts at the same price.

This decision did not come quickly. Our managers conducted research for a year to investigate costs and to obtain government permits. We believe the move will enhance our service and help us pursue new markets. As our business evolves, we remain dedicated to our customers. This does not imply any job losses; all staff will keep their positions.
zh:
經過仔細研究，公司決定把主要倉庫遷到桃園。這次搬遷能讓我們更快配送產品，並應付越來越多的訂單。

搬遷會影響部分服務約兩週。為了減輕員工的壓力，我們會雇用搬家公司，並優先處理緊急訂單。若有任何延誤，會以電子郵件通知顧客。

我們也修改了配送計畫。較大的訂單會附上追蹤號碼，老顧客可以用相同價格續約。

這個決定並非倉促做出。我們的主管花了一年時間調查成本並取得政府許可。我們相信搬遷能提升服務，並幫助我們開拓新市場。隨著業務發展，我們仍然全心為顧客服務。這並不表示會有人失業，所有員工都會保留職位。
q: How long will services be disrupted?
The move will disrupt some services for about two weeks。
What will large orders come with?
Larger orders will be accompanied by a tracking number。

en:
This report reviews our manufacturing results for October and highlights key points for November.

Output rose by 8 percent, giving our sales team a strong boost. The new line in Factory B is still underperforming, but engineers are monitoring it daily and estimate it will reach full speed by mid-November.

To streamline work, managers have been asked to delegate more tasks and to allocate staff where they are needed most. We have also broadened our product range: two new models will be released next month.

A supplier has declined to lower prices, so we are reviewing a bid from another company and may substitute some parts. One customer remarked that our team had addressed every complaint quickly, a sign that we can thrive even in a hard market. We assume costs will stay stable. If anyone needs to retrieve older reports, they are available on the shared drive. The government has granted us a tax break for using clean energy.
zh:
本報告回顧十月的生產成果，並點出十一月的重點。

產量增加了 8%，給業務團隊帶來很大的推動力。B 廠的新產線仍然表現不佳，但工程師每天都在監測，預估它會在十一月中達到全速。

為了簡化工作流程，主管被要求更多授權、把人力分配到最需要的地方。我們也擴大了產品線：下個月將推出兩款新型號。

一家供應商拒絕降價，所以我們正在審查另一家公司的投標，可能會替換部分零件。一位客戶評論說，我們的團隊迅速處理了每一項抱怨，這表示即使在艱困市場中我們也能蓬勃發展。我們假設成本會保持穩定。如需調閱舊報告，可在共用硬碟上找到。政府已核准給我們使用潔淨能源的稅務優惠。
q: What is said about the new line in Factory B?
The new line in Factory B is still underperforming。
Why is the company reviewing another bid?
A supplier would not lower prices
A supplier has declined to lower prices。

en:
For entrepreneur Amy Lo, the idea came from her own workstation. "I saw how much packaging our office threw away," she said. Two years later, her enterprise makes boxes from farm waste, and it has just completed a merger with a larger company.

The implication for the industry is clear. Rising inflation has pushed up the price of plastic, a key commodity, while new rules on emissions mean that firms must show compliance with stricter standards.

Amy works in conjunction with several contractors and keeps the payroll small. Her team uses a simple workflow, and every product is tested against a benchmark set by government labs. The company has had a deficit only once.

Recognition has followed. Amy was named chairperson of a national business group, and her correspondence with investors shows strong interest. She still meets clients on her own premises, in casual attire. Firms can claim a tax deduction for using her products.
zh:
對創業家羅艾美來說，這個點子來自她自己的工作站。她說：「我看到我們辦公室丟掉了多少包裝。」兩年後，她的企業用農業廢料製作紙箱，而且剛完成與一家大公司的合併。

這對產業的含意很清楚。通膨上升推高了塑膠這種重要原物料的價格，而新的排放規定也表示企業必須證明符合更嚴格的標準。

艾美與幾家承包商合作，並讓薪資規模保持精簡。她的團隊使用簡單的工作流程，每項產品都會依照政府實驗室訂定的基準測試。公司只出現過一次赤字。

她也因此獲得肯定。艾美被選為一個全國商業團體的主席，她與投資人的往來書信顯示對方很有興趣。她仍在自己的場所穿著輕便服裝與客戶見面。企業使用她的產品可申請稅務扣除。
q: Where did Amy get her idea?
I saw how much packaging our office threw away。
What has the company just completed?
it has just completed a merger with a larger company。

en:
The board meeting minutes confirm that the rollout of our new app will start in March. This initiative is a key part of our five-year portfolio plan.

The blueprint for the launch was created after several boardroom discussions. There was strong consensus among stakeholders that improved connectivity is our top priority. Our cofounder, Ben Su, stressed that the app must be easy to use, as a common misconception is that customers enjoy complex features.

The project requires additional capital, but it is expected to improve profitability within two years. As justification, the team pointed to a 30 percent increase in customer inquiries about mobile services.

Each sales team will be given a quota for app sign-ups. Staff should check their login credentials before training begins. We will also introduce a code of conduct for app support so that our integrity is never in doubt. The plan respects our company hierarchy, but all ideas are welcome, as we aim to build a strong digital ecosystem.
zh:
董事會會議紀錄確認，新 App 將於三月開始推出。這項計畫是我們五年投資組合規劃的關鍵部分。

推出的藍圖是經過幾次董事會議室討論後擬定的。利害關係人之間有強烈共識：改善連線能力是首要任務。共同創辦人蘇班強調，App 必須容易使用，因為一個常見的誤解是顧客喜歡複雜的功能。

這個專案需要額外的資金，但預計兩年內能提升獲利能力。團隊提出的理由是，顧客對行動服務的詢問增加了 30%。

每個業務團隊都會分配 App 註冊的配額。訓練開始前，員工應檢查自己的登入憑證。我們也會為 App 客服訂定行為準則，讓我們的誠信不受質疑。這個計畫尊重公司層級，但歡迎所有想法，因為我們的目標是打造強大的數位生態系。
q: What is the top priority, according to stakeholders?
improved connectivity is our top priority。
What justification did the team give for the project?
the team pointed to a 30 percent increase in customer inquiries about mobile services。

en:
Pacific Foods announced today that it has completed the acquisition of Sunrise Snacks, a subsidiary of a Japanese group. The deal gives Pacific a broader clientele and better control of its logistics.

According to the specification of the deal, Sunrise shareholders will receive cash and an equity stake in Pacific. An independent appraisal valued Sunrise at $80 million. Pacific has also promised a dividend increase next year.

The company's vision is to become the region's leading snack maker. However, it faces some constraints. A backlog of orders at Sunrise must be cleared, and a small discrepancy in last year's accounts is being checked. There have been no allegations of wrongdoing.

Pacific plans to use analytics to improve the retention of key customers and will offer incentives to Sunrise staff to stay. Managers will have discretion over local pricing. Analysts note that the accumulation of cash in recent years, and a surplus in its budget, gave Pacific the credibility to make the deal. Its affiliation with major supermarkets will also help.
zh:
太平洋食品今天宣布，已完成收購日本某集團旗下子公司日出點心。這項交易讓太平洋擁有更廣泛的客群，並更能掌控物流。

根據交易規格，日出的股東將獲得現金和太平洋的股權。一份獨立鑑價評估日出的價值為 8,000 萬美元。太平洋也承諾明年提高股利。

公司的願景是成為該區最大的點心製造商。不過它面臨一些限制。日出積壓的訂單必須消化，去年帳目中的一項小差異也正在核查。目前沒有任何不當行為的指控。

太平洋計劃用數據分析提高重要客戶的留存率，並提供誘因讓日出員工留任。經理對當地定價有自主決定權。分析師指出，近年累積的現金和預算盈餘，讓太平洋有足夠的公信力完成這筆交易。它與大型超市的合作關係也會有所幫助。
q: Sunrise shareholders will receive cash and an equity stake in Pacific。
What is one constraint Pacific faces?
A backlog of orders at Sunrise must be cleared。

en:
The annual audit of our procurement process has been completed. The auditors noted strong oversight overall but made several recommendations.

First, expenditure on new prototypes rose sharply. While this reflects our expertise in product design, the auditors recommend making provision for unexpected costs. Second, staff turnover in the purchasing team was high, which slowed the onboarding of new suppliers.

The report also covers the functionality of our ordering system. Some orders for consignment goods were not recorded properly. The infrastructure team has agreed to fix this by June.

With new legislation on sustainability coming into force, the company must also review its suppliers' practices. Globalization has made our supply chain more complex, and a recession could reduce our proceeds. The auditors noted that staff entitlements, including severance pay, were handled correctly. As a large conglomerate, we must lead by example.
zh:
本公司採購流程的年度稽核已經完成。稽核人員指出整體監督良好，但提出幾項建議。

第一，新原型的支出大幅增加。雖然這反映了我們在產品設計上的專業，稽核人員建議為意外成本預留準備金。第二，採購團隊的人員流動率偏高，拖慢了新供應商的導入。

報告也涵蓋訂購系統的功能。部分寄售商品的訂單沒有正確記錄。基礎架構團隊已同意在六月前修正。

隨著永續相關新法規生效，公司也必須審查供應商的作業方式。全球化使我們的供應鏈更加複雜，經濟衰退可能減少我們的收益。稽核人員指出，員工應得權益，包括資遣費，都已正確處理。身為大型企業集團，我們必須以身作則。
q: What did the auditors recommend about prototype costs?
the auditors recommend making provision for unexpected costs。
What problem slowed the onboarding of new suppliers?
staff turnover in the purchasing team was high, which slowed the onboarding。

en:
After a computer crash last month exposed weaknesses in our systems, the board has made cybersecurity a top concern. Here is a short update for all staff and shareholders.

Our executive team has hired an outside auditor to check every system. The goal is to reduce our liability if client data is lost. Staff with proficiency in IT will form a new team, and each member will report to a senior manager rather than to a subordinate role.

The auditor's insight was clear: the general ledger and payroll files were not protected well enough. New metrics will track how quickly problems are fixed. The board expects synergy between the IT and finance teams.

We will also cease using older software that has no patent support. Outreach to clients will explain these steps, with respect to each demographic group. Reimbursement for training costs is available, and the new rules apply in every jurisdiction where we work. No collateral damage to client accounts has been found.
zh:
上個月的電腦當機暴露出系統弱點後，董事會已把網路安全列為首要關注事項。以下是給全體員工和股東的簡短更新。

我們的高階主管團隊已聘請外部稽核員檢查每個系統，目標是降低客戶資料遺失時的責任。精通 IT 的員工將組成新團隊，每位成員直接向資深經理報告，而不是向下屬職位報告。

稽核員的見解很清楚：總帳和薪資檔案的保護不夠。新的指標將追蹤問題修復的速度。董事會期望 IT 和財務團隊能產生綜效。

我們也會停止使用不再有專利支援的舊軟體。對客戶的外展說明會解釋這些措施，並顧及每個人口族群。訓練費用可申請核銷，新規定適用於我們營運的每個管轄區。目前沒有發現客戶帳戶受到附帶損害。
q: Payroll and ledger files were not well protected
The IT team was too big
the general ledger and payroll files were not protected well enough。
New metrics will track how quickly problems are fixed。

en:
The preliminary results of our feasibility study on a new factory in Thailand are now available.

The study found the plan to be viable. Labor costs are considerably lower, and the local government offers substantial support. Conditions there are conducive to long-term growth, and demand in the region is expected to remain strong for the foreseeable future.

The team, led by renowned consultant Dr. Lee, also noted some risks. Power cuts are prevalent in rural areas, so the factory may need its own generator. Without this, drastic delays would be inevitable. A breach of supply contracts could follow if we are not prompt in solving the problem.

Both white-collar and factory staff would be hired locally. Each manager would be accountable for their respective team. Accessibility to ports is excellent, and the plan is complementary to our existing factory in Vietnam. Influential partners in a business syndicate have shown interest. The plan is plausible, but more checks are needed.
zh:
我們在泰國設立新工廠的可行性研究初步結果已經出爐。

研究認為這個計畫可行。人工成本低很多，當地政府也提供大量支持。當地條件有利於長期成長，可預見的未來中該區需求預期會維持強勁。

由知名顧問李博士帶領的團隊也指出一些風險。鄉村地區常常停電，所以工廠可能需要自備發電機。若沒有發電機，嚴重延誤將無法避免。若我們不能迅速解決問題，可能會導致違反供應合約。

白領和工廠員工都會在當地招募。每位經理都要為各自的團隊負責。前往港口的交通非常便利，這個計畫也和我們在越南的現有工廠互補。一個商業聯盟中具影響力的夥伴已表示興趣。這個計畫合理可信，但需要更多查核。
q: What risk did the study mention?
Power cuts are prevalent in rural areas。
How does the plan relate to the factory in Vietnam?
the plan is complementary to our existing factory in Vietnam。

en:
An established and prestigious consulting firm is seeking an outstanding Senior Strategy Manager to join our diversified team.

The ideal candidate will have comprehensive knowledge of fiscal planning and contractual matters, along with strong managerial skills. You must be able to explain sophisticated ideas in an intuitive way and spot the underlying causes of business problems.

We work with prospective clients from many industries, and some of our largest accounts were dormant before we helped them grow again. Exceptional communication skills are imperative. Decisions must be fair and never arbitrary.

Applicants must have legitimate work rights in Taiwan. Prominent candidates from the banking sector are also welcome. Your experience will be invaluable to our clients, especially during periods of adverse market conditions. The definitive list of duties will be given at the interview.
zh:
一家具規模、聲譽卓越的顧問公司正在徵求一位傑出的資深策略經理，加入我們多元化的團隊。

理想人選需具備財務規劃和合約事務的全面知識，以及優秀的管理能力。你必須能以直觀的方式說明複雜的概念，並找出商業問題的根本原因。

我們與各產業的潛在客戶合作，有些最大的客戶在我們協助它們重新成長之前曾停滯不前。卓越的溝通能力是必要條件。決策必須公正，絕不能專斷。

應徵者必須在台灣具有合法工作權。也歡迎來自銀行業的傑出人選。你的經驗對客戶來說將非常寶貴，尤其是在市場情況不利的時期。最終的職務清單會在面試時提供。
q: What skill is described as imperative?
When will the definitive list of duties be given?
The definitive list of duties will be given at the interview。

en:
MedCore, a multinational pharmaceutical company, has opened a state-of-the-art office in Taipei. The decision was strategic: Taiwan is one of the foremost markets for medical technology in Asia.

The office was designed by an accomplished architect and includes ergonomic chairs and quiet rooms. Some staff will work offsite at client hospitals. MedCore said the investment was unprecedented in its 40-year history.

The company has been pragmatic about risk. After it was found deficient in some safety checks last year, it took preemptive action and hired new inspectors. A provisional review found no negligent behavior by staff.

MedCore's research center will focus exclusively on cancer drugs. Some products are exempt from import taxes, and the company will price them accordingly. Ultimately, it hopes to hire 200 people in Taipei and Taichung, respectively. Insightful leaders say intermittent supply problems remain a challenge.
zh:
跨國藥廠 MedCore 在台北開設了一間最先進的辦公室。這項決定具有策略性：台灣是亞洲醫療科技最重要的市場之一。

辦公室由一位成就卓越的建築師設計，配備符合人體工學的椅子和安靜室。部分員工會在客戶醫院等外部地點工作。MedCore 表示，這筆投資在公司 40 年歷史中前所未有。

公司在風險方面很務實。去年在部分安全檢查中被發現有缺失後，它採取了預防措施並聘請新的檢查員。一份暫時性的審查沒有發現員工有疏失行為。

MedCore 的研究中心將專門研究癌症藥物。部分產品免繳進口稅，公司會據此定價。最終它希望在台北和台中分別雇用 200 人。有見地的領導者表示，斷斷續續的供應問題仍是一項挑戰。
q: What will the research center focus on?
MedCore's research center will focus exclusively on cancer drugs。
What did MedCore do after failing some safety checks?
it took preemptive action and hired new inspectors。

en:
The Financial Supervisory Commission has unanimously approved new rules to regulate online lending companies, as interest rates continue to fluctuate.

Under the rules, lenders must disclose all fees before a loan is signed and assess each borrower's ability to repay. Lenders that fail to comply may face fines. The commission will oversee the changes and coordinate with banks to expedite reviews.

Officials said the goal is to deter companies that exploit young borrowers and to help people attain financial security. Lenders may not solicit customers by phone or withhold information about late fees.

Many in the industry have embraced the rules. Some firms are already planning to restructure their services and reconcile their records with the new standards. "These rules complement our own efforts," said one executive. Experts perceive the move as a sign that the government will take a firmer approach. The commission will administer the rules and initiate checks from next year.
zh:
由於利率持續波動，金融監督管理委員會一致通過了規範網路借貸公司的新規定。

根據規定，放款業者必須在簽約前揭露所有費用，並評估每位借款人的還款能力。不遵守的業者可能遭到罰款。委員會將監督這些改變，並與銀行協調加快審查。

官員表示，目標是遏止剝削年輕借款人的公司，並幫助民眾達到財務安全。業者不得以電話招攬客戶，也不得隱瞞滯納金的資訊。

業界許多人接受了這些規定。有些公司已計劃重整服務，並讓紀錄符合新標準。一位主管說：「這些規定與我們自己的努力相輔相成。」專家認為此舉顯示政府將採取更強硬的做法。委員會將執行這些規定，並從明年開始進行檢查。
q: What must lenders do before a loan is signed?
lenders must disclose all fees before a loan is signed。
What are lenders not allowed to do?
Lenders may not solicit customers by phone。

t: How We Cut Costs Without Layoffs
en:
When sales fell last year, many firms chose to downsize. We decided on a different path, and the results have surpassed our expectations.

First, we asked managers to compile a list of every expense. This helped us consolidate three offices into one and utilize the space better. We also reallocated staff to the teams that needed them most rather than letting people go.

Second, we tried to economize on travel. Instead of flying, teams convene online. When problems escalated, a trained staff member would mediate before things got worse. We also helped the IT team troubleshoot old systems instead of buying new ones.

The experience illustrates a simple point: careful planning can help a company succeed without hurting morale. We believe in fostering trust, and we advocate open discussion of costs. Staff are entitled to know why decisions are made. Of course, we still incur some costs we cannot avoid. Our plan does not encompass every situation, and no staff member was asked to disengage from their projects. Company phones were not confiscated, as some rumors had claimed.
zh:
去年業績下滑時，許多公司選擇裁員。我們選了另一條路，結果超出預期。

首先，我們請主管彙整每一項支出清單。這幫助我們把三間辦公室合併成一間，並更善用空間。我們也把員工重新分配到最需要人手的團隊，而不是讓人離開。

其次，我們設法節省差旅費。團隊改在線上開會，不再搭飛機。當問題升高時，會由受過訓練的員工在情況惡化前出面調解。我們也協助 IT 團隊排除舊系統的故障，而不是購買新系統。

這個經驗說明了一個簡單的道理：仔細規劃能幫助公司在不打擊士氣的情況下成功。我們相信培養信任，也提倡公開討論成本。員工有權知道決策的原因。當然，我們仍會產生一些無法避免的成本。我們的計畫無法涵蓋所有情況，也沒有要求任何員工退出他們的專案。公司手機並沒有像某些傳聞說的被沒收。
q: What did the company do instead of laying off staff?
We also reallocated staff to the teams that needed them most rather than letting people go。
How did teams save on travel?
Instead of flying, teams convene online。

en:
Dear Mr. Park,

We appreciate the services your company has provided over the past five years. However, we have decided to terminate our cleaning contract, effective March 31.

This decision follows a review designed to optimize costs and mitigate risks. We have chosen to outsource cleaning to a company that can deploy staff across all our sites. The quality of service at two locations had deteriorated, and our attempts to elicit a response from your managers were not successful.

We authorize you to bill us for services until the end of March. Please note that fees accrue only for work completed. Any payment that deviates from the contract terms will not be accepted.

To facilitate the change, please designate a contact person who can help the new company navigate our buildings. We will also curtail the use of your storage room from February. We did not wish to depreciate your work; your team was an example of good service for many years. We will commence the handover on March 1 and disseminate the details to all departments.

Sincerely,
Facilities Manager
zh:
朴先生您好：

感謝貴公司過去五年提供的服務。不過，我們決定終止清潔合約，自 3 月 31 日起生效。

這項決定是在一次旨在優化成本、降低風險的審查之後做出的。我們選擇把清潔工作外包給一家能在所有據點派遣人員的公司。兩個地點的服務品質已經下降，而我們試圖取得貴公司主管回應的努力也沒有成功。

我們授權貴公司請款至三月底。請注意，費用只依已完成的工作累計。任何偏離合約條款的付款都不會被接受。

為了讓交接順利，請指派一位聯絡人，協助新公司熟悉我們的大樓。我們也會從二月起減少貴公司對儲藏室的使用。我們無意貶低貴公司的工作，多年來你們的團隊一直是優質服務的典範。我們將在 3 月 1 日開始交接，並把細節傳達給所有部門。

敬上
總務經理
q: Why is the contract being ended?
The quality of service at two locations had deteriorated。
What is Mr. Park asked to do?
please designate a contact person who can help the new company navigate our buildings。

en:
Our coffee franchise will open 20 new stores this year. Here are the key points from Monday's briefing.

First, we must formulate a clear plan for each city. Managers should gauge local demand and leverage our brand to attract partners. A shortlist of five cities will be chosen by May.

Second, rising costs could impede growth. To offset higher rents, we will dispatch shared delivery vans to several stores. We expect this to alleviate pressure on store budgets.

Third, partners who leave in the first year will forfeit their deposit. The contract does not entail any extra fees, and partners will be reimbursed for training costs.

We also want to reiterate that a surge in online orders has helped sales. We will monetize our app by adding a paid membership. Managers should liaise with the marketing team and debrief their staff after the meeting. If a store fails, we will liquidate its stock quickly. We attribute last year's success to teamwork, and we expect this plan to yield strong results. We will also institute monthly reviews.
zh:
我們的咖啡加盟體系今年將開設 20 家新店。以下是週一簡報的重點。

第一，我們必須為每個城市擬定清楚的計畫。經理應評估當地需求，並善用我們的品牌吸引合作夥伴。五個城市的入選名單將在五月前決定。

第二，成本上升可能阻礙成長。為了抵銷較高的租金，我們會派遣共用的送貨車服務幾家店。我們預期這能減輕門市的預算壓力。

第三，第一年內退出的加盟夥伴將喪失保證金。合約不涉及任何額外費用，夥伴的訓練費用也會獲得補償。

我們也要重申，線上訂單激增帶動了業績。我們將在 App 加入付費會員制來獲利。經理應與行銷團隊聯繫，並在會後向員工匯報。如果有門市經營失敗，我們會迅速清算庫存。我們將去年的成功歸功於團隊合作，預期這個計畫會帶來亮眼的成果。我們也將建立每月檢討制度。
q: What happens to partners who leave in the first year?
They must find a new partner
partners who leave in the first year will forfeit their deposit。
How will the company offset higher rents?
To offset higher rents, we will dispatch shared delivery vans to several stores。
